Both modes reseed42 again before constructing an independent loader. The source loader uses the same identity sampler, fixed generator seed and training transformations. Actual input/initial-state equality has not been measured locally.

Only the second mode replaces that model instance router.conditions with a closure calling its original bound method under autocast disabled and casting both incoming evidence tensors to float. No detach, parameter substitution, altered query scale, altered loss, or change to expert values is introduced.
Forward hooks on all six condition-sequence modules register observational tensor-gradient hooks and implicitly return None. They do not replace forward output or gradient.

Parameter gradients are inspected after existing step has unscaled gradients, attempted the optimizer update, and updated the scaler. Updated is asserted on each step. Hook gradients are from scaled loss backward and are correctly named scaled_output_gradient.
The diagnostic creates an exclusive output directory and writes two condition reports plus a combined report. It makes no checkpoint save/load or evaluation calls, and does not start formal training.

interpretation_limits: Local Python has no torch. No tensor, CUDA, AMP, dtype, gradient magnitude, training, numerical reproduction, or efficacy test was run by this reviewer.

Reports contain three losses but final-step parameter gradients and final-step forward/backward hook witnesses only; observed entries are replaced on every forward. Do not describe them as a per-step gradient history.
Hook gradients are loss-scaled, while parameter.grad summaries are unscaled. Compare dtypes/nonzero patterns and account for recorded scaler values when comparing magnitudes.
FP32 condition execution is a controlled numerical intervention, not proof of the precise underflow location. Dtype hooks and actual gradient reports must establish the observed effect.

Because each mode makes three updates, later parameters can diverge in response to precision differences. Results test the paired three-step recipe; they are not a fixed-weight backward-only ablation.
The native branch should first be compared with original losses and failed predicate names. Exact repeatability is an actual deployment observation, not proven by matching source recipe.

Diagnostic success cannot satisfy the complete M0 gate or authorize50-epoch development. Any production fix requires narrow review and actual fresh exclusive M0 receipts, preserving the original failure.
